thread:
Alex M: hey team — just got a missed pager alert in the morning digest. I was scheduled primary 14:00-22:00 UTC but my flight got delayed. i can’t reliably take alerts from 16:30–19:00 UTC. sorry, my phone’s basically on airplane mode.
Jia W: ack. do we have secondary on call for that window?
Samir K: Priya is listed as secondary for today (per the schedule spreadsheet) but iirc she’s paired on a customer demo at 17:00.
Priya R: i’m on the demo until ~17:30 UTC. i can flip to cover 17:30–22:00 if someone can cover 16:30–17:30.
Alex M: okay — short window 16:30–17:30 needs coverage. incident-bot shows no active incidents right now, but if something pages during that window we need quick ack.
Samir K: i can take 16:30–17:00 as standby and do triage if pages come in; if it’s noisy passed 17:00 i can escalate to Priya when she’s free.
Jia W: thanks. Alex, can you update the oncall slack status + the rota doc? i’ll also post a short note to #general so ops knows the temporary handover.
Alex M: done — updated my Slack status and added a note in the rota: "Alex delayed flight — Samir 16:30–17:00, Priya 17:30–22:00; standby handover 17:00–17:30 remains Samir->Priya". link: https://redwood.internal/schedule/oncall-rotations (runbook link)
Priya R: thanks. quick checklist reminder for the person covering: 1) check pager routing in PagerDuty -> infra-prod; 2) have the runbook open: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra-prod-oncall ; 3) if latency > 5s for >10% p50 traffic, escalate per page flow.
Samir K: pinging incident-bot to confirm no recent alerts.
incident-bot: [automated] No active alerts in infra-prod for the last 30 minutes. Most recent alert: 1777711200 - embedding-service-high-latency - resolved.
Jia W: can someone also update the oncall calendar event so calendar shows the mini-swap? avoids double-book. I can edit if you want to throw me edit rights.
Alex M: granted edit to Jia. please also set a 5-min post-handback sync at 17:35 so Priya and Samir can confirm clean state.
Priya R: will do — added 17:35 quick-check to calendar.
Samir K: brief note — if a pager comes in while i’m driving (rare), text me and i’ll try to ACK; if no reach, escalate to oncall escalation policy (page sequence: Priya -> infra leads -> SRE pager).
Jia W: perfect. small follow-ups: 1) Alex, open a tiny postmortem doc if missed pages happen or if the handoff had friction; 2) we should log this temporary swap in the #oncall-swaps thread for auditing.
Alex M: will do. creating a short entry and linking the calendar.
Priya R: thanks all. Samir, i’ll DM you right before 17:30 to confirm handover status.
Samir K: sounds good.
Alex M: appreciate the cover — back on my end to monitoring after landing, will check in when online. :plane:
Jia W: closing loop — i updated the rota doc, calendar, and posted the swap notice in #oncall-swaps. everything else looks good. :thumbsup:
